title: Owner Auto Policy Self-Service Reference: Lifting a Named Driver Exclusion at the Named Insured's Request
content:
**What this governs.** The lift premium on the Owner Auto Policy is the additional premium charged when the named insured lifts the exclusion of the driver on the term's latest claim report recording a named excluded driver. It applies only to that driver; a lift for any other excluded driver is not decided by this rule. Lifting an exclusion is an add with a prior status of excluded, made on the named insured's own signed request.

**Conditions of the add.**
- A driver is added as a rated driver only when the driver's violation points do not exceed the package's maximum points.
- The rated drivers on the term may not exceed the package's maximum rated drivers.
- A person excluded on one open policy may not be rated on another open policy of the same named insured.

**Prerequisites.** The additional premium for lifting a named driver exclusion is fixed only after the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form by signing date, when it names a household resident reported operating a scheduled vehicle on a claim of the term while unlisted who carries no driver-added entry on the term, has its exclusion endorsement recorded, apart from a form whose endorsement would take the currently excluded drivers past the package's maximum number of excluded drivers while the driver being lifted is still counted among them. The additional premium for lifting a named driver exclusion is not fixed until the household resident on the term's latest claim report recording an unlisted household resident, when rated earlier in the term by a driver-added entry and not named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form, carries a driver-added entry dated after that claim's date of loss.

**Which premium applies.** For a lift of that driver's exclusion, and only for that lift, the additional premium is the lift premium. Two other listings keep their own rules:
- the re-listing of the household resident on the term's latest claim report recording an unlisted household resident, when that resident was rated earlier in the term by a driver-added entry and is not the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form;
- the listing that precedes the exclusion of the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form by signing date, when that resident is reported operating a scheduled vehicle on a claim of the term while unlisted and carries no driver-added entry on the term.

Every other driver added is still charged the driver's full-term premium share multiplied by the days from the change effective date to the expiration date and divided by the term's days.

**Business effect of the write.** The named insured personally signs the request. One call:
- records a driver-added change on the term, with prior driver status excluded and the given change effective date and full-term premium share;
- carries the driver's date of birth, relationship and violation points from that driver's most recent entry on the term;
- when the amount is above zero, books one additional premium entry (reason driver added, effective on the change date, carrying the amount and days charged, linked to the change);
- raises the term's net written premium by that amount.

Once the call completes, the person is no longer excluded and shows as a rated driver.

**How it is invoked.** `lift_driver_exclusion_0b127d81` is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it over to the customer, and the customer themselves runs it with the figures the representative states.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_policy_id` | Reference number of the customer's Owner Auto Policy term, given by the representative from the policy term lookup | identifier |
| `driver_name` | Full name of the household member whose exclusion is lifted, exactly as the customer states it, with no change in spelling, order or punctuation (verbatim) | text |
| `change_effective_date` | The date the person is covered again from 12:01 a.m., as the representative states it | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `driver_term_premium` | The full-term premium share for the person as a rated driver, as the representative states it, in USD | 2 decimal places |
| `additional_premium` | The additional premium charged for lifting the exclusion, as the representative states it, in USD | 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `added_days` | The number of days of the term the additional premium covers, as the representative states it | integer, 0 or more, calendar days |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming:
- the person now rated;
- the term reference number;
- the change reference number;
- the change effective date (YYYY-MM-DD);
- the additional premium transaction reference number, with its amount in USD to 2 decimal places and its days.

The presence of both reference numbers means the exclusion was lifted.
